title: I made a picture crossword game using AI-generated images – CrossPix is now live on Google Play! 🧩
author: Melodic_Bother_1376
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋  
I'm a solo indie developer, and my new mobile puzzle game, **CrossPix**, is now officially available on Google Play! 🎉  
The idea is simple: **AI-generated images are the clues**, and your goal is to discover the hidden words and complete each crossword puzzle.  
I wanted to explore how AI-generated visuals could become an actual part of the gameplay rather than just decoration.  
Here's what's in the game:  
🧩 200 picture crossword puzzles  
🎨 AI-generated visual clues  
📅 Daily challenges and collectible monthly pictures  
🏆 Achievements and unlockable themes  
🌍 15 languages, including English  
The game is **free to play**, with optional ads and in-app purchases.  
📱 **Google Play:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=hu.crosspix.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=hu.crosspix.game)  
I'd love to hear your honest thoughts!  
**Do you think AI-generated images work well as the core of a picture puzzle game?**  
And if you give CrossPix a try, I'd especially appreciate feedback on the puzzle difficulty, visual style, and overall experience.  
Thanks for checking it out! ❤️
